Theme

Travel & transport · Town, shops & places

courier noun

also delivery person, letter-carrier, postman, mailman, mail carrier, postwoman, deliver mail

classical

Cic. Att. 12.1.2
Traupman 167, 363
M-O s.v. mailman

tabellārius, tabellāriī m.

noun, second declension

letter-carrier or courier

Using it for a parcel delivery person is a modern application. tabellārius is derived from tabella.

Other words

  • cursor, cursōris m. — runner or courier

    noun, third declension · also used · classical

    cursor from currō; English cursor reflects this family.

Examples

  • Tabellārius adest.

    The delivery person is here.composed

  • tabellārius litterās heri reddidit

    the postman delivered the letter yesterdayTraupman 96, 302

  • Tabellārius litterās heri reddidit.

    The mailman delivered the letter yesterday.Traupman 302

See also messenger, writing tablet, post office, postbox.

SourcesLewis & Short: tabellarius · Lewis & Short: cursor

The example sentences marked “composed” are ours.
